scope: DC/V/H/SMOOTH/SMOOTH_V/SMOOTH_H/PAETH searches on fixed and adaptive partitions, SB64, YUV420, 8/10/12-bit
format: untouched aomenc OBU and complete independent libdav1d planar references
ffmpeg_version: ffmpeg version 9.0.1-full_build-www.gyan.dev Copyright (c) 2000-2026 the FFmpeg developers
built with gcc 16.1.0 (Rev2, Built by MSYS2 project)
reference_test_encoding: lossless value/count RLE; every coded-depth YUV sample and public RGBA pixel is compared by av1_reference_planes_wbtest.mbt

fixtures.transform_type: intra default DCT/ADST selected according to mode and transform size
fixtures.mode_coverage_note: encoder mode searches are enabled; individual chosen prediction symbols are not inferred from header traces

fixtures.color_matrix_note: unspecified CICP uses the existing BT.601-family conversion
